responsibility: Implements the inlining heuristics and pass drivers for both early inlining and whole-program IPA inlining. It enforces growth limits, chooses recursive and size-based inlining candidates, removes now-unneeded bodies, and coordinates the pass pipeline that decides which callgraph edges are inlined before and after IPA analysis.
same_name_distinction: Contains the inliner’s executable heuristics and pass bodies, including early inlining, whole-program IPA inlining, growth-limit enforcement, flattening, recursive handling, and pass registration. Unlike gcc/ipa-inline.h, it makes inlining decisions and runs transforms rather than only exposing cache types and helper entry points.
